cbb.secondary_postseason_field_model.rationale: Title probability for these events is non-monotone in team strength: strong teams are removed by NCAA selection (now 44 at-large places in a 76-team field, which takes more of the old NIT top seeds), the 2027 NIT reserves 12 of its 24 places for the best eligible team of each of the top-10 KenPom conferences plus a second ACC and SEC team, regular-season champions of other leagues enter automatically only at an average metric rank of 125 or better, and the Crown takes top non-NCAA teams of its partner leagues; declines and Crown contractual preclusion (about 15 schools in 2026) are common. Pricing with NCAA bracket logic or strength alone gives the strongest teams probabilities that are in fact near zero.
cbb.secondary_postseason_field_model.measurement: Joint Monte Carlo with the NCAA selection draw (cbb.committee_ordinal_seed_model, 76-team field) at pricing time t. NIT 2027 (24 teams): (1) rank conferences by KenPom conference rating as of Selection Sunday (simulated forward from t); for each of the top 10, the exempt bid goes to its highest-ranked team not in the NCAA field, plus a second exempt bid to the next such ACC team and SEC team (12 exempt, all hosting); (2) automatic bids to every regular-season conference champion (outright or by the league's tiebreak) not in the NCAA field whose mean rank across the NIT selection metrics (reported as NET, KenPom, BPI, KPI, SOR, Torvik, WAB; equal-weighted, simulated end-of-season ranks) is <=125; (3) remaining places filled by best mean metric rank among non-NCAA teams. Crown: apply the last published slot rule (2026: top two non-NCAA teams each of the Big Ten, Big 12 and Big East plus two committee wild cards, eight teams) until a 2027 rule is announced, and remove Crown teams from NIT eligibility. Each invited team accepts with p = event-and-tier decline rate from the last 3 invitation/decline lists shrunk to the event mean with weight n/(n+20); declined places pass to the next team in rank order. Then simulate the event bracket with cbb.ratings_fundamentals (campus sites for NIT rounds before the final, home edge to the higher seed; neutral for the Crown). As-of: rule table versioned by announcement date (NIT 2027 rules announced 1 Oct 2026); all ranks as of t.
raw_data: NIT and Crown slot rules by season with announcement dates
per-team NET, KenPom, BPI, KPI, SOR, Torvik and WAB ranks (daily vintages)
regular-season conference champions and tiebreak outcomes
NIT and Crown invitation, decline and preclusion lists by season
P(not in NCAA field) from the selection draw
free_sources: NCAA.com/NCAA.org NIT announcements and selection procedures (2027 structure announced 1 Oct 2026)
Fox Sports/AEG College Basketball Crown press releases
KenPom conference ratings (subscription for full history)
NCAA NET archive and team sheets

cbb.tournament_field_format.rationale: Verified for 2027 (NCAA announcement, 7 May 2026): the men's and women's fields expand to 76 teams with 32 automatic and 44 at-large bids; the 12 lowest-seeded at-large teams and 12 lowest-seeded automatic qualifiers play 12 Opening Round games (First Four name dropped) and the 12 winners join 52 teams in the 64-team bracket. This raises bubble probabilities for teams ranked about 37-50, adds a game for 24 teams, and makes KXMARMADROUND's 'Round of 76' a make-the-field contract.
cbb.tournament_field_format.measurement: Season table, versioned by announcement date: 2027 = field 76; automatic bids 32 (one per conference champion); at-large 44; Opening Round games 12 = the 12 lowest-seeded at-large teams paired among themselves and the 12 lowest-seeded automatic qualifiers paired among themselves, played Tuesday-Wednesday after Selection Sunday (Dayton plus a second site); 12 winners join 52 directly placed teams in a 64-team, six-round bracket, so an Opening Round team needs 7 wins for the title and every other team 6; seed list 1-76 on the S-curve with bracket-integrity rules from the NCAA principles document (conference separation by round). Simulation maps each team's S-curve position to its path accordingly; seed lines of Opening Round games are taken from the published 2027 principles when released, else assumed to be the lowest at-large lines (about 10-12) and the lowest automatic lines (15-16).

cbb.bracket_sim.measurement: Monte Carlo: sample team strengths from posterior, simulate remaining regular season with home advantage, conference tiebreakers, conference tournament brackets and the NCAA field as defined by cbb.tournament_field_format (2027: 76 teams, 32 automatic and 44 at-large bids, 12 Opening Round games before the 64-team bracket); model seed list construction or use bracket consensus; output pmf for advancement and seeds.

cbb.bracket_seed_statistic_sim.measurement: From cbb.bracket_sim (100,000 tournaments using current ratings with posterior sd, bracket as published or simulated seeds before Selection Sunday): per simulation compute (a) for each round r and seed k, number of #k seeds reaching r and winning in r; (b) number of games in round r won by the higher numerical seed; (c) sum of official seeds of the four semifinalists; (d) max over all games of (winner seed - loser seed) where positive, with and without the 12 Opening Round games (formerly the 4 First Four games; 2027 field of 76); (e) for each round r, the highest numerical seed reaching r (title-only KXMARMADHIGHSEED). Output the pmf of each statistic; calibrate to 1985-present seed-level history via a check of mean counts.

cbb.player_game_exposure_tournament.rationale: Total team-games in the tournament are fixed by the format, but they concentrate on strong teams; a star on a 1 seed averages several games, a star on a 16 seed one or two. Subtle: the Opening Round counts (12 games and 24 teams from 2027, replacing the 4-game First Four), so play-in teams add a game, and a changed field size changes the count. The market trades through the tournament window, so exposure must be recomputed as teams are eliminated and as a milestone either occurs (settling YES) or becomes unreachable with fewer games left.

cbb.milestone_union_aggregation.measurement: Monte Carlo: simulate the bracket (with the 12-game Opening Round of the 2027 76-team field) N >= 50,000 times; for each simulated game draw active players' stat lines from their per-game models (minutes linked to game margin and OT); YES if any line hits the milestone; report P(YES) and the contribution share of the top 10 players; compare with the analytical 1 - prod(1 - p_i)^{E[games_i]} as a check.

cbb.wcbb_title_probability.mechanism: The women's champion is decided by a separate bracket that also expands to 76 teams (12 Opening Round games) in 2027; a combo contract pays only if the named women's team also wins, so the women's marginal is a required factor.

cbb.auto_bid_structure.measurement: For each of the 32 conferences with an automatic bid (2027): tournament format and seeding (cbb.conf_tournament_format_table); simulate the bracket to get P(each team wins the bid); a bid thief is a winner not otherwise in the at-large top 44, and each thief moves the at-large cut up one place; champions with the 12 lowest S-curve positions among automatic qualifiers play in the Opening Round, so a one-bid league's title path adds a game. Output per team P(auto bid) and per bubble team the distribution of the at-large cut position.

cbb.committee_protocol_vintage.rationale: Quadrant definitions and metric lists have been revised (for example the addition of WAB, adjustments to quadrant thresholds) and the 2027 field grows to 76 teams with 44 at-large places (verified, NCAA 7 May 2026); a model fit on earlier years can be mis-specified for the current protocol.
